relevant 
documents 
_Second 
Section) 
必須先經過第一階段校內申請通過，且經過國際處向姐妹校提名後，才有資格進行第
二階段(姊妹校)申請。 
⚫ 所有的繳交資料統一整合成一個 PDF檔 (一個學生一個 PDF檔) +ID photos(學
生證大頭照) 統一寄信到 outbound@ccu.edu.tw 
⚫ 繳交文件: 
. 1. Application form(with a photo attached) (pdf) 
. 2. Certification of Enrollment (pdf) 
. 3. Certification of Transcript (pdf) 
. 4. A photocopy of passport (pdf) 
. 5. Proof of English Proficiency for those whose first language is not English and would like 
to take courses in English in DAU) 
. 6. 1 Photo(jpg) 
. 7. Certificate of Insurance(pdf) from home country(recommended) 
*for those who get insurance in his/her own country 
 8. Certificate of health including Tuberculosis(pdf) 
. *Inspections for Tuberculosis must be done in hospitals appointed by hospitals in 
provinces appointed by the Korean embassy(If a visa application includes a 
tuberculosis test, you do not need to submit it)
